newsitem.title: USA: ITT Educational Services enrollment up.
newsitem.headline: ITT Educational Services enrollment up.

text.p: ITT Educational Services Inc, a private college system, said Wednesday that as of March 31 total student enrollment at its ITT Technical Institutes was 22,172, up nine percent from 20,354 at March 1996.
Enrollment at ITT Technical Institutes open more than 24 months increased six percent to 21,418 students as of March 31, 1997, versus 20,132, the company said.

ITT Educational said it also posted a three percent increase in new student enrollment for the 1997 March term, with a total of 4,363 new students compared with 4,240 new students for the same term in 1996.
The number of first-time students enfolling in the 1997 March term was 3,619, up two percent from the 3,563 reported for the same term last year.
Same-college new student enrollment in the March 1997 term was 4,186, compared with 4,127 last year, an increase of slightly more than one percent.

"Coming off a 10 percent increase in total student enrollment for all of 1996, we are encouraged to see our record enrollment trends continue," said Rene Champagne, chairman, president and chief executive of ITT Educational.

"With year-ago new student enrollment gains of 28 percent, we were prepared for a tough comparison for this year's March term," Champagne said, adding the company is pleased with the level of overall new students.
"With an encouraging contribution from all of our newly opened colleges, we are well positioned to continue our long-term record of consistent earnings growth in 1997," Champagne said.
ITT Educational operates 59 ITT Technical Institutes in 26 states.
